result:
Complete. All seven files are written and every checker passes:

- **`static_check.js`**: ok (no syntax errors, unbound identifiers, or duplicate declarations)
- **`runtime_check.js`**: nonblank canvas, 193 animation frames, 1832 scene objects, 1946 pixel changes (visible motion), zero page errors
- **`node elevator_logic_test.js`**: 7/7 deterministic tests pass (lobby rush, destination priority, starvation, direction handling, door hold/safety cap, toFloor handshake, reset)

Key implementation points: pure SCAN elevator brain in `elevator_logic.js` with anti-starvation guards; `world.js` builds the transparent 6-floor building with a real 3-unit entrance gap and the full `outside → front_door_threshold → entrance → lobby_center` nav chain; `sim.js` runs lockstep clock/motion at 120x, 20 workers + 80 recyclable visitors with schedules, seat reservations with explicit `RELEASE_SEAT`, seated-facing enforcement via per-waypoint `sitTargets`, boarder lane-entry and collision exemptions, stall recovery, and day/night lighting with HUD sliders.
cost_note: Qoder uses Credits and the CLI does not report per-run USD cost
